note: Seeds for inventing a sense. A named sense is worth nothing on its own. Every drawn seed must be answered on all four required fields (what it detects, the organ or mechanism, how daily life and culture bend around it, the new suffering or misunderstanding it creates). A sense that creates no new problem has not been invented, only decorated.
required_fields: detects: the exact stimulus, stated so that a false positive is describable
mechanism: the organ, substrate, or procedure, including its failure mode
consequence: how ordinary life, architecture, manners, or law reorganize around it
cost: the new pain, misunderstanding, or injustice it makes possible
